_comment: What folk say about deeds and about the player. Keys: a deed kind, default_good / default_bad for kinds without lines, title_<title> for what a town thinks of the player, memory_good / memory_bad for what someone remembers. {player} and {town} are filled in. Files add to each other's lines unless they say "replace": true.

default_good: They say {player} did right by the folk of {town}.
I hear {player} has been a help to {town}.
default_bad: They say {player} did wrong by the folk of {town}.
Folk in {town} have nothing good to say of {player}.
quest:completed: They say {player} did what {town} asked, and more.
In {town} they say {player} can be counted on.
{player} saw a job through for {town}, I hear.
quest:failed: {player} promised {town} a thing and never delivered, I hear.
economy:donation: {player} put coin in {town}'s coffers, so I hear. Generous.
economy:property: They say {player} has bought property in {town}.
{player} owns a house in {town} now, I'm told.
repair:helped: They say {player} helped put {town} to rights after the damage.
{player} lent a hand mending {town}, I hear.
repair:funded: They say {player} paid for {town}'s repairs out of their own purse.
npc:rescue: They say {player} saved a life in {town}.
In {town} they'll tell you {player} pulled someone from death's door.
defense:monster_slain: They say {player} cut down the beasts that troubled {town}.
{player} kept {town} safe from the things in the dark, I hear.
defense:raid_repelled: They say {player} stood with {town} when the raiders came.
Without {player}, {town} would have burned. That's what they say.
social:festival: They say {player} was the life of {town}'s festival.
law:theft: Watch your purse: they say {player} is a thief. Ask anyone in {town}.
Something went missing in {town}, and they say {player} took it.
In {town} they lock their doors when {player} passes.
law:pickpocketing: They say {player} has quick fingers. Folk in {town} found their purses lighter.
Keep your hand on your coin if {player} is about. {town} learned the hard way.
law:lockpicking: They say {player} was caught at a lock in {town}.
No lock in {town} stopped {player}, so I hear.
law:trespass: They say {player} was found where they had no business in {town}.
law:poaching: They say {player} took what wasn't theirs from {town}'s pastures.
law:vandalism: They say {player} smashed up part of {town}. Some fool.
law:assault: They say {player} beat someone bloody in {town}.
{player} is quick with their fists, so they say in {town}. Keep clear.
law:murder: Have you heard? They say {player} killed someone in {town}.
There's blood on {player}'s hands. {town} is still burying its dead.
In {town} they say {player} is a murderer. They want to see them hang.
law:robbery: They say {player} robbed travellers on the road by {town}.
{player} held up a caravan near {town}, so they say.
law:jailbreak: They say {player} broke out of {town}'s jail.
law:resisting_arrest: They say {player} fought the guard in {town} rather than face justice.
law:pillory: They put {player} in the pillory in {town}. I'd have liked to see that.
{player} spent a day in {town}'s stocks, I hear. Rotten cabbages and all.
title_outlaw: Here they say you're an outlaw. If I were you I'd not linger.
Folk here want you gone, or hanged. I'd keep my hood up.
title_distrusted: Folk here don't trust you. Can't say I blame them.
People keep an eye on you here, and not a kind one.
title_stranger: Folk here don't know you. You're just a face passing through.
Nobody here has much to say about you, good or bad.
title_known: Folk know your face here. That's a start.
People here have heard your name. Nothing bad.
title_friend: Folk here count you a friend of {town}.
You're well liked in {town}. People say your name kindly.
title_burgher: You're one of us now, a burgher of {town}, with your own roof here.
Folk here count you a neighbour. You own property in {town}, after all.
title_householder: You keep a house in {town} now. Swear the burgher's oath and you'll be one of us.
A householder of {town}. The reeve will take your oath when you've earned it.
title_hero: You're the hero of {town}. Folk will be telling stories of you for years.
Children here play at being you. The hero of {town}!
memory_good: And I'll not forget what you did for me.
For my part, I owe you.
memory_bad: And I've not forgotten what you did to me.
For my part, I remember what you did.
